title: Neck Aids
description: Cervical collars and neck supports for post-operative care, whiplash management, and cervical spondylosis.

products.name: Cervical Collar with Support
features: Firm yet comfortable foam construction with adjustable velcro closure
Breathable fabric cover that reduces heat build-up
Contoured chin and neck support for anatomical fit
Washable outer cover for hygiene maintenance
benefits: Limits cervical spine movement to promote healing
Reduces neck muscle strain and fatigue during recovery
Suitable for post-operative immobilisation and cervical spondylosis
Lightweight design allows all-day comfortable wear

products.name: Philadelphia Collar
features: Rigid anterior and posterior polyethylene shells with foam lining
Ventilation cutouts to maintain airflow and patient comfort
Adjustable chin height to accommodate different neck lengths
Hook-and-loop fasteners for easy donning and doffing
benefits: Provides firm cervical immobilisation for trauma and post-surgical cases
Prevents unwanted cervical rotation and flexion
Commonly used in emergency and hospital settings for spinal precaution
Durable construction suitable for extended clinical use

products.name: Hard Cervical Collar
features: Rigid thermoplastic shell for maximum cervical control
Padded inner liner for patient comfort
Adjustable height mechanism to fit various neck profiles
benefits: Delivers maximum cervical immobilisation for fractures and dislocations
Reduces risk of secondary spinal injury during transport and rehabilitation
Supports post-surgical fusion sites to ensure proper healing
Widely used in orthopaedic and neurosurgical aftercare

products.name: Soft Cervical Collar
features: Soft polyurethane foam core with smooth fabric cover
Lightweight and discreet for everyday use
Velcro closure for easy size adjustment
benefits: Gently restricts neck movement to relieve muscle spasm and soreness
Provides warmth and proprioceptive support for chronic neck stiffness
Ideal for managing mild whiplash and cervical muscle strain
Comfortable enough for prolonged wear throughout the day
